282	## Scaling Rules
283	
284	### When to add a sub-department
285	- A sub-department exceeds 8 agents → split or add granularity
286	- A new niche or capability emerges with no clean home → new sub-dept
287	- Two agents repeatedly collide on scope → may indicate sub-dept split
288	
289	### When to add a department
290	- Top-level dept exceeds 25 agents AND can split cleanly along function lines
291	- New strategic pillar approved by Yash (e.g., future "Sales", "Customer Success", "Legal")
292	
293	### When to add a pod
294	- Pods are reserved for engineering stack-specific clusters (pod-a / pod-b / pod-c)
295	- Other departments don't currently use pods
296	- New stack added → new pod (e.g., pod-d if AI-only stack ever splits from Stack A)
297	
298	### When to merge sub-departments
299	- Sub-dept has ≤2 agents for >90 days AND function overlaps with adjacent sub-dept
300	- Cadence proposes merge in monthly review
